branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A cheese of San Martín, Peru, flavoured with cecina, a cured pork of the region. It won first place in the Innovation category of the 2024 national contest, for the brand De la Vaca a la Boca.

sources.text: The cheese and the contest place, from the news report.
